description: Design sources for T1 item 1: the generator, its pinned parameter file, the generated RTL, the hand-written streaming wrapper, and the gate-level netlist derived from them. Generator identity: this repository's own rtl/gen at the commit that adds this file (no external generator is pinned); generated output is reproduced by rtl/regen.sh from rtl/params/fft256.params, whose sha256 is in the first lines of each rtl/generated file. The netlist is mapped to sky130_fd_sc_hd at the tt_025C_1v80 liberty corner; the freshness check re-hashes the RTL sources, parameters and netlist against synth/fft256.synth.report.json (cheap mode, no PDK needed, --skip-deck). The full re-run (klt synthesize ... --check ... --rerun) needs Yosys and the PDK and is run locally. Supersedes manifests/item1-inventory.json and its attestation manifests/item1-attestation.json (recorded evidence, kept unchanged), which hashed rtl/gen/emit.py before issue #162 taught the emitter the model's mid-pipeline stage-width reduction (each stage drops max(0, prev+1-w) LSBs rounded convergent, the twiddle fraction and a stage B drop rounded once combined in the multiplier): the production Verilog stays byte-identical, but the emitter's own content hash moved. The same sources, derived files and checks are carried unchanged.
